text_block_list.text:
—Enveloped by deafening cheers, <chrname> seized a 
brilliant victory.

Seeing our three-legged race take shape 
like this filled me with an indescribable 
joy and pride.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful race, little lamb! 
...Or perhaps it is rude to call you a 
little lamb now?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>, you are undoubtedly her best 
partner!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
You've carved out another great 
achievement.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
In time, the hoofprints you have left 
behind will surely serve as a guide for 
other travelers.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'd love to see it. The running of 
those who inherit your history.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
...However, the race between the two of 
them isn't over yet.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
The great success and fulfillment of the 
Umamusume is the wish of the Three 
Goddesses. And because we wish for it, we 
want to test them.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
The stage where you learn whether the 
Umamusume you raised through thick and 
thin has reached the pinnacle of running—

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
From her past runs and how she runs now, I 
shall judge whether <chrname> is fit to stand upon 
that grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
If you should cross paths with each other, 
you must face her as an opponent you need 
to defeat.

And so, having firmly proven <chrname>'s growth, 
the SWBC came to a close.
